context.transcript:
Good afternoon, everyone.
I hope all of you have read the product report I emailed yesterday.
I'm very proud to announce that our refrigerator won last year's industry award for energy efficiency.
I've also looked at the customer reviews.
They were largely positive, with most users commenting on the large capacity of the refrigerator.
One thing we could improve on is the selection of colors.
Our marketing team thinks we'd sell more units if we made our refrigerator available in brighter colors.
context.transcript_translation:
Good afternoon, everyone.
我希望你们都阅读了昨天我发送的产品报告。
我非常自豪地宣布，我们的冰箱获得了去年的行业能效奖。
我也看了客户评论。
它们大多是积极的，大多数用户评论了冰箱的大容量。
我们可以改进的一点是颜色选择。
我们的营销团队认为，如果我们用更鲜艳的颜色推出这款冰箱，销量会更高。
